feature_policy: Only non-target-derived numeric Phase 3 features are stored in ArticleFeatures; category_id/subcategory_id remain relational labels, not ML features.
runtime_boundary: Actual SQL Server execution requires a user-provided SQL Server instance, credentials or Windows authentication, and an installed ODBC driver. The build environment has no live SQL Server and no pyodbc module, so no fictitious server import is claimed.
